name: thor_fp16_gemm
description: D[M,N] = A[M,K] @ B[N,K]^T with fp16 inputs and output and fp32 accumulation, on NVIDIA Thor (sm_110a).
layout: A row-major [M,K], B row-major [N,K] (both K-major), D row-major [M,N]

correctness.inputs: torch.randn fp16, one generator per seed
correctness.rule: every element finite and |D - ref| <= atol + rtol * |ref|; output poisoned with NaN before each checked call; timing reuses the first seed's buffers refilled in place with the last seed's data, and the output is re-checked against that data after timing

timing.timer: CUDA events around each timed call, L2 flushed between calls; median per trial, then median across trials
timing.slow_rule: implementations whose single call takes at least slow_call_ms (compute-bound, e.g. the initial kernel) are timed first, on their own, for all trials
timing.ramp_rule: then cuBLAS runs untimed for ramp_s seconds so the GPU and memory clocks reach their top state
timing.interleave_rule: then every trial times each remaining implementation (cuBLAS included) back to back, rotating the order; each first runs untimed for settle_s seconds

score.speedup_vs_initial: sum(initial kernel median ms) / sum(candidate median ms) over all shapes
score.ratio_vs_cublas: sum(cuBLAS median ms) / sum(candidate median ms) over all shapes
